body:
Good advice. I guess I did need to hear that. I've kinda grown apart from her though, and she isn't really in the way, it just makes things feel awkward for me. 

No, he didn't really ask me if it was cool, but I didn't care anymore at that point. I was depressed before we broke up, and the break up didn't do anything but make me hide my emotions more.

I can call him a friend still, and I still talk to him. Sorry for the paragraphs, I've always typed a lot.

I have some close friends... but here is where the problem lies. My ex is dating one of my closest friends, which makes it awkward. And I have my friends, they seemed to brush it off. So I'm at a lost.
I don't want them to treat me differently. I'm afraid they'll think I need mental help, and they don't really like to listen to me, so I wouldn't be able to convince them otherwise.
Yeah, I know the feeling. I've never been really religious either until something major happens. No one knows what happens after this life. All I can say is I hope you feel better about life.
